description: This file defines the UserController class for Drupal, handling user-related routes such as password reset, user profile access, logout, and account cancellation.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller class for handling user-related routes such as password reset, profile access, logout, and account cancellation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as date formatter, user storage, user data, logger, flood service, and time service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate UserController with services from the container.

methods.name: resetPass
methods.description: Redirects to the user password reset form, handling one-time login link processing.

methods.name: getResetPassForm
methods.description: Returns the password reset form or throws exception if session data is invalid.

methods.name: resetPassLogin
methods.description: Validates and processes a one-time login link, logs in the user, and redirects to profile edit.

methods.name: determineErrorRedirect
methods.description: Checks validity of user, timestamp, and hash; redirects if invalid.

methods.name: validatePathParameters
methods.description: Validates hash and timestamp for login link authenticity.

methods.name: userPage
methods.description: Redirects logged-in user to their profile page.

methods.name: userEditPage
methods.description: Redirects logged-in user to their profile edit page.

methods.name: userTitle
methods.description: Returns the display name of the user for page titles.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and redirects to front page.

methods.name: confirmCancel
methods.description: Handles account cancellation confirmation via email link, validating parameters and invoking user_cancel.
